title: Etale residue triple ideal refinement
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $p$ a prime, $K$ a field, and $\chi:\kappa(p)\to K$ a field homomorphism. For a triple $t=(B,\alpha,q,\phi)$ in [def-weil-pbc-etale-residue-triples] and $f\in q$, there are a triple $s=(B_s,\alpha_s,q_s,\phi_s)$ and a morphism $a:t\to s$ whose underlying ring map sends $f$ into the ideal $pB_s$, the extension along $\alpha_s$.

proof.text: For the etale map R -> B and q over p, Stacks Tag 00U4(1) gives p B_q = q B_q. Hence f/1 belongs to the extension of pB to B_q. Clearing the finitely many denominators in this ideal membership gives g outside q such that gf belongs to pB.

Use the principal localization B[1/g]. Its map to K extends since g has nonzero image; the kernel prime and fraction-field embedding define a compatible residue triple as in the unit-refinement construction. Spec(B[1/g]) -> Spec(B) is the principal open immersion, hence is etale by lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation(1); its composite to Spec(R) is etale by clause (2). In B[1/g], the image of gf lies in pB[1/g]; multiplying by the inverse of g puts the image of f in this ideal.

proof_origin: Stacks Project Tags 04GN and 04GP, with kernel and residue-field constructions; second reading by D2, 2026-10-12.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleResidueTriple_ideal_refinement
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (p : Spec R) (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (χ : (Spec R).residueField p ⟶ CommRingCat.of K)
    (t : EtaleResidueTriples R p K χ) (f : t.B) (hf : f ∈ t.q.asIdeal) :
    ∃ (s : EtaleResidueTriples R p K χ) (a : t ⟶ s),
      ((etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram R p K χ).map a).hom f ∈
        p.asIdeal.map s.α.hom
